actions.action: Separate naming directions from wording variants
actions.mechanism: Group suggestions by their stated naming rationale, not spelling similarity; keep every underlying direction visible.
actions.implementation: Require a rationale and addressed constraints. Allow multiple direction memberships, reversible grouping, and original-record retrieval; hide authors during first review.
actions.check: Enter two similar names with different rationales; verify both directions remain visible and each original suggestion remains recoverable.
actions.risk: Forced categories could erase ambiguity; allow ungrouped suggestions and disputed memberships.

actions.mechanism: A rejection records its reason and applicable constraint version, making changed premises detectable without automatically reversing decisions.
actions.implementation: Store rejection explanations and linked constraints. When a constraint changes, flag dependent rejections for reconsideration, preserving previous explanations and decisions.
actions.check: Reject a name against a constraint, then edit that constraint; verify its rejection is flagged while unrelated rejections remain unchanged.
actions.risk: Some rejections lack constraint dependencies; retain free-text reasons without inventing links.

actions.action: Give late suggestions an anonymous first review
actions.mechanism: A separate review inbox prevents prior attention and visible authorship from substituting for consideration of a new rationale.
actions.implementation: Hide authors and reaction counts in first review; retain access-controlled authorship records. Use a disclosed arrival-order queue; require rationale comparison before marking duplicates.
actions.check: Submit a late, similarly worded alternative with a different rationale; verify anonymous access and that duplicate dismissal requires an explicit explanation.
actions.risk: Rationale text may identify authors; warn contributors before submission.

actions.action: Keep hard-constraint conflicts visible beside popular names
actions.mechanism: Explicit eligibility evidence prevents popularity from obscuring a hard constraint, without selecting a winner or deleting suggestions.
actions.implementation: Add a constraint matrix with meets, conflicts, and unknown states plus explanations. Keep conflicting names visible; periodically reopen parked directions for manual review.
actions.check: Give a hard-constraint-violating name many reactions; verify its conflict remains prominent. Reopen a parked direction and recover rationale, rejection history, and authorized authorship.
actions.risk: Constraint assessments can be disputed; expose uncertainty and permit corrections.
